params.label: Target

options.label: 8-bit unsigned (uint8)
options.help: Smallest; lossy from anything wider unless you rescale

options.label: 32-bit float (float32)
options.help: Preserves negatives + fractions from math; 2× the disk of uint16

params.label: Rescale

options.label: Auto (per-channel min–max → full range)
options.help: Stretches each channel independently — preserves visual contrast when shrinking to uint8

options.help: No remap — high values above the target's max saturate

params.tip: How to map source values onto the target dtype's range
